AgentArchitecture.Overview: Create a production-ready FIDO2/WebAuthn Relying Party Server in Rust with complete conformance to FIDO Alliance specifications. The architecture implements a highly secure, scalable authentication service supporting passwordless authentication flows. Built with enterprise-grade patterns including comprehensive error handling, audit logging, rate limiting, and multi-environment deployment readiness. Designed for high availability with async processing, connection pooling, and horizontal scaling capabilities.

Component.name: WebAuthn Core Service
Component.Description: Core FIDO2/WebAuthn operations implementing W3C WebAuthn Level 2 specification
Component.Responsibilities: Challenge generation and validation, credential registration verification, authentication assertion processing, attestation statement validation, origin verification, user presence validation

Component.name: HTTP API Gateway
Component.Description: RESTful API layer with comprehensive middleware stack
Component.Responsibilities: Request routing and validation, CORS handling, rate limiting, request/response serialization, authentication middleware, audit logging, error response formatting

Component.name: Data Access Layer
Component.Description: Persistent storage management with connection pooling and transaction support
Component.Dependencies: sqlx 0.7.x with PostgreSQL driver, deadpool-postgres, redis 0.24.x
Component.Responsibilities: User account management, credential storage and retrieval, session state management, challenge caching, audit trail persistence, connection pool management

Component.name: Security Service
Component.Responsibilities: Cryptographic operations, timing attack prevention, origin validation, challenge entropy verification, credential policy enforcement, security header management

Component.name: Configuration Manager
Component.Responsibilities: Environment variable loading, configuration validation, secret management integration, feature flag support, runtime configuration updates

Component.name: Observability Service
Component.Description: Comprehensive monitoring, logging, and metrics collection
Component.Responsibilities: Structured logging, distributed tracing, performance metrics, error tracking, health check endpoints, audit log generation

Endpoint.Description: Initialize credential registration flow with challenge generation
Endpoint.RequestType: RegistrationStartRequest { username: String, display_name: String, user_verification: Option<String> }
Endpoint.ResponseType: PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions with challenge, user info, RP info, supported algorithms
Endpoint.SecurityConsiderations: Username uniqueness validation, challenge entropy verification, origin validation, rate limiting per user

Endpoint.Description: Complete credential registration with attestation verification
Endpoint.ResponseType: RegistrationResult { success: bool, credential_id: Option<String>, errors: Vec<String> }
Endpoint.SecurityConsiderations: Attestation statement validation, challenge replay prevention, credential uniqueness enforcement, backup eligibility tracking

Endpoint.Description: Initialize authentication flow with challenge generation
Endpoint.ResponseType: PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions with challenge, allowed credentials, timeout, user verification
Endpoint.SecurityConsiderations: User enumeration prevention, challenge uniqueness, credential filtering by user, timeout enforcement

Endpoint.ResponseType: AuthenticationResult { success: bool, user_id: Option<String>, session_token: Option<String>, errors: Vec<String> }
Endpoint.SecurityConsiderations: Signature verification, counter validation, user presence verification, session token generation, credential counter update
Session validation, user authorization, credential privacy protection

Endpoint.RequestType: Authenticated request with credential_id path parameter
Endpoint.SecurityConsiderations: Credential ownership validation, prevent last credential deletion, audit logging

Endpoint.ResponseType: HealthStatus { status: String, database: String, redis: String, timestamp: String }
Endpoint.SecurityConsiderations: No sensitive information exposure, rate limiting

Principle.name: Defense in Depth
Principle.Implementation: Multi-layered validation including input sanitization, business logic validation, database constraints, and output encoding. Rate limiting at multiple levels with progressive penalties.

Principle.name: Challenge Security
Principle.Implementation: Cryptographically secure random challenges using ring::rand, minimum 32-byte entropy, unique per request, time-bound expiration with cleanup, stored in Redis with TTL.

Principle.name: Origin Validation
Principle.Implementation: Strict origin checking per WebAuthn Level 2 specification, allowlist-based validation, subdomain handling, development environment exceptions with warnings.

Principle.name: TLS Enforcement
Principle.Implementation: HTTPS-only in production, HSTS headers, certificate pinning for critical endpoints, TLS 1.3 minimum, secure cipher suites only.

Principle.name: Zero Trust Authentication
Principle.Implementation: No implicit trust, every request validated, session tokens with expiration, credential-level authorization, user verification enforcement.

Principle.name: Data Protection
Principle.Implementation: Sensitive data encryption at rest, PII anonymization in logs, secure credential storage, backup encryption, key rotation procedures.

Principle.name: Attack Prevention
Principle.Implementation: Timing attack mitigation using constant-time operations, CSRF protection, XSS prevention headers, SQL injection prevention with prepared statements.

Environment.name: Development
Environment.Configuration: Docker Compose with PostgreSQL 15, Redis 7, self-signed TLS certificates, debug logging enabled, relaxed CORS, development origin allowlist, hot reload support

Environment.name: Staging
Environment.Configuration: Kubernetes deployment with managed PostgreSQL, Redis Cluster, Let's Encrypt certificates, structured JSON logging, production-like CORS, staging origin validation, performance profiling enabled

Environment.name: Production
Environment.Configuration: Kubernetes with HPA, managed PostgreSQL with read replicas, Redis Cluster with persistence, Load balancer with SSL termination, structured logging to ELK stack, strict security policies, monitoring and alerting

Environment.name: High Availability
Environment.Configuration: Multi-region deployment, PostgreSQL with streaming replication, Redis Sentinel, CDN for static assets, health checks and circuit breakers, automated failover, disaster recovery procedures

Strategy.name: Comprehensive Error Types
Strategy.Implementation: Custom error enums for WebAuthn, database, validation, and network errors. Error chain preservation with anyhow. Structured error responses with correlation IDs.

Strategy.name: Graceful Degradation
Strategy.Implementation: Circuit breaker patterns for external dependencies. Fallback mechanisms for non-critical features. Retry logic with exponential backoff.

Strategy.name: Security-Conscious Error Handling
Strategy.Implementation: Generic error messages for user-facing responses. Detailed logging for internal debugging. Timing attack prevention in error paths.

Strategy.name: Environment-Based Configuration
Strategy.Implementation: Hierarchical configuration with environment variables, configuration files, and runtime overrides. Validation on startup with descriptive error messages.

Strategy.name: Secret Management
Strategy.Implementation: Integration with HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or Kubernetes secrets. No secrets in configuration files or environment variables in production.

Strategy.name: Feature Flags
Strategy.Implementation: Runtime feature toggling for gradual rollouts, A/B testing, and emergency shutoffs. Integration with feature flag services for remote management.

Strategy.name: Unit Testing
Strategy.Implementation: Comprehensive unit tests for all business logic using Rust's built-in test framework. Mock external dependencies. Property-based testing for cryptographic functions.

Strategy.name: Integration Testing
Strategy.Implementation: API endpoint testing with real database connections using testcontainers. WebAuthn flow end-to-end testing with simulated authenticators.

Strategy.name: Security Testing
Strategy.Implementation: Penetration testing automation, dependency vulnerability scanning with cargo-audit, OWASP compliance verification, timing attack detection.

Strategy.name: Performance Testing
Strategy.Implementation: Load testing with realistic user scenarios, latency benchmarking, memory usage profiling, database query optimization verification.

Strategy.name: Async Processing
Strategy.Implementation: Tokio runtime with optimal thread configuration, async database operations with connection pooling, concurrent request handling with backpressure.

Strategy.name: Caching Strategy
Strategy.Implementation: Redis for session state and challenge caching, application-level caching for configuration and user data, CDN integration for static content.

Strategy.name: Database Optimization
Strategy.Implementation: Proper indexing strategy, query optimization with EXPLAIN analysis, read replica usage for reporting, connection pool tuning.

Strategy.name: Resource Management
Strategy.Implementation: Memory-efficient data structures, zero-copy operations where possible, resource cleanup and connection management, horizontal scaling readiness.
